_comment: Cards for tests/unit/combat/test_players_attacked_by.py. `t_destiny_angel` is Angel of Destiny's end-step line without its life-total condition, so the player spec can be watched on its own: a 2/2 whose end-step trigger makes each player it attacked this turn lose the game. The bears and the planeswalker come from other test files.

cards.name: Test Destiny Angel
cards.oracle_text: At the beginning of your end step, each player this creature attacked this turn loses the game.
